Interesting facts

Legacy paint description:
A paint that somewhat reduces the damage inflicted by Smoky and Isida while doing much more to protect against Thunder explosions. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
